audit_scope.description: This batch covers EL-focused specifications: INVALID opcode (EIP-141), extended stack manipulation (EIP-8024), nonce limits (EIP-2681), empty account cleanup (EIP-161), CLZ opcode (EIP-7939), BLAKE2F precompile (Prague), EL-to-CL request framework (EIP-7685), local builder blob limits (EIP-7872), and Homestead fork rules (EIP-2). All are EL-centric with EIP-7685 providing an EL-to-CL interface.

in_scope: Account State Management (nonce limits, empty account cleanup)
Contract Creation (gas semantics, nonce overflow handling)

misclassified_entities.reason: Contract Logic in EIP-141 is internal smart contract code executing within the EVM, not an external entity sending data into the system.
Validated Transaction in EIP-2681 is an internal construct representing a transaction that already passed validation within the EL pipeline.
EVM Execution Context in EIP-2681 is an internal component of the EL that triggers CREATE/CREATE2 opcodes.

trusted_external_entities.name: User via JSON-RPC (Transaction Submission)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users submit transactions including those that trigger INVALID opcodes, CREATE/CREATE2 with nonce limits, and EIP-7685 request-generating transactions. All input is unauthenticated and potentially malicious. Covers EXT-TRANSACTION from EIP-141 and EXT-TX-SUBMITTER from EIP-2681, EIP-7685, and EIP-2.

trusted_external_entities.name: Smart Contract via BLAKE2F Precompile Call
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any smart contract can invoke the BLAKE2F precompile with arbitrary 213-byte input data. Input must be validated for exact length (213 bytes) and final flag value (0 or 1). Gas cost is rounds * GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND. Covers EXT-CALLING-CONTRACT from BLAKE2F.

trusted_external_entities.name: Local Builder Configuration (Blob Limits)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Local configuration under operator control. Authenticated by filesystem permissions. Value must be validated and clamped to protocol bounds with minimum floor of 1. Covers EXT-BUILDER-CONFIG from EIP-7872.

trusted_external_entities.name: Fork Protocol Parameters (Chain Config)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Protocol parameters (MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK, fork block numbers) are compiled into the client. Authenticated via software release process. Covers EXT-FORK-PARAMS from EIP-7872.

trusted_external_entities.name: Physical Network Environment
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Network conditions affect block propagation timing and blob availability. Adversarial network conditions (eclipse attacks, bandwidth throttling) are possible. Covers EXT-NETWORK-ENVIRONMENT from EIP-7872.

trusted_external_entities.name: Blob Transactions in Mempool
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Blob transactions originate from untrusted users. Full validation required before block inclusion. Covers EXT-BLOB-TXS from EIP-7872.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Transactions may trigger INVALID (0xfe) opcode execution. The EVM must correctly consume all remaining gas and revert state changes. Nested CALL contexts must only revert the inner frame. Transaction signature s-value must be <= secp256k1n/2 (EIP-2). Nonce must be < 2^64-1 (EIP-2681).

When account nonce reaches 2^64-1, CREATE/CREATE2 must return 0 without executing initcode and without deducting initcode gas. Contract creation gas is 53,000 (EIP-2). Empty accounts created during execution must be cleaned up (EIP-161).

Transactions that trigger request generation via system contracts must have requests correctly accumulated, sorted by type, filtered for empty data, and committed via SHA256 hash in the block header (requests_hash). The EL must not omit or forge requests.

Input must be exactly 213 bytes. Final flag (byte 212) must be 0 or 1. Gas cost = rounds * GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND. InvalidParameter exception raised for invalid inputs. The compression function must execute in constant time to prevent timing side channels.
Configuration value clamped to min(protocol_max, user_value) with floor of 1. Misconfiguration can cause revenue loss (too low) or propagation failure (too high but not above protocol max).
Blob transactions from mempool must be fully validated before inclusion. Builder must respect both protocol limits and configured blob limits.
